pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā sattarasavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ talasattikaṃ uggiranti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.6: ime āvuso chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā amhākaṃ talasattikaṃ uggirantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā sattarasavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ talasattikaṃ uggirissantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.9: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave kupitā anattamanā sattarasavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ talasattikaṃ uggirathā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.12: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā kupitā . . . uggirissatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.13: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.14: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc75:1.15.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa kupito anattamano talasattikaṃ uggireyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
